hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 buy-and-burn hook: buys collect 1% of ETH input into a burn pot; sells queue 1% of tokens for burning. Every 20 swaps a buyback-and-burn can be triggered. Sells revert in the same block as a buyback and can be gated by a per-token tx.origin allowlist: any address can permissionlessly enable the sell gate via compress(), while adding addresses and disabling the gate are deployer-only.
